title: FJ62 (1987) rebuild, and 1HZ diesel swap
transmission: H55F manual with 75-series bellhousing adapted for 1HZ - requires 21-spline fine-pitch input shaft (33311-60170) and 1HZ/HD-T flywheel
ai_summary: An in-progress, heavily documented rebuild-and-1HZ-swap of a 1987 FJ62 in Durban, South Africa, replacing the factory 3F petrol engine with a reconditioned 1HZ diesel. Builder sourced a 75-series bellhousing and the correct 21-spline input shaft/flywheel needed to mate the diesel to the H55F gearbox, while also addressing significant body rust and a cracked cab mount caused by deteriorated engine cushions.

complications.detail: Petrol H55F uses a 10-spline input shaft incompatible with 1HZ; required 21-spline fine-pitch shaft and correct flywheel
Cab-mount crack found, attributed to deteriorated engine cushions; welded repair pending new bushings, plus significant gutter/fender rust requiring donor FJ60 panels
